title: Promotions
author: KremlinKittens
selftext:
Just wanted to share a few of my non-commercial side projects on itch.io:

[https://skazochnick.itch.io/](https://skazochnick.itch.io/)



And my commercial game, Voidborne Tactics, available on Google Play:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.perevodgames.voidbornetactics](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.perevodgames.voidbornetactics)



A quick note about AI: I have nearly 15 years of professional software engineering experience and I use AI primarily as a productivity boost rather than a replacement for my own skills and experience.



Game development is a passion of mine and I work on these projects in my spare time simply because I love making games!
